news.title: Which NHL coaches have the most wins in history?
news.ruTitle: Which NHL coaches have the most wins in history?
news.description: Scotty Bowman leads all NHL coaches in wins all-time. Find out who else makes the list.

news.title: Simon Holmstrom has first hat trick in Islanders' 6-2 win over Ducks 6-2
news.ruTitle: Simon Holmstrom has first hat trick in Islanders' 6-2 win over Ducks 6-2
news.description: — Simon Holmstrom had his first career hat trick, Matthew Schaefer added three assists and the New York Islanders rolled to a 6-2 victory over the Anaheim Ducks on Saturday night.

news.title: Marchment lifts Sharks to shootout win over Mammoth
news.ruTitle: Marchment lifts Sharks to shootout win over Mammoth
news.description: — Mason Marchment flicked in a wrist shot in the fifth round of a shootout to lift the San Jose Sharks to a 6-5 win over the Utah Mammoth on Saturday night.

news.title: Oettinger makes 22 saves as the Stars beat the Sabres 2-0
news.ruTitle: Oettinger makes 22 saves as the Stars beat the Sabres 2-0
news.description: — Jake Oettinger made 22 saves to lead the Dallas Stars to a 2-0 win over the Buffalo Sabres on Saturday night, just two days after being pulled after allowing a season-high six goals.

news.title: Connor Hellebuyck makes 43 saves and improves to 7-0 with Devils in 7-4 win over Capitals
news.ruTitle: Connor Hellebuyck makes 43 saves and improves to 7-0 with Devils in 7-4 win over Capitals
news.description: — Connor Hellebuyck recovered from a shaky start to make 43 saves, remaining unbeaten in net with New Jersey as the surging Devils defeated the Washington Capitals 7-4 on Saturday night.

news.title: Avalanche beat Canadiens 4-1 without injured stars MacKinnon, Makar
news.ruTitle: Avalanche beat Canadiens 4-1 without injured stars MacKinnon, Makar
news.description: — Artturi Lehkonen had a goal and an assist and the short-handed Colorado Avalanche beat the Montreal Canadiens 4-1 on Saturday night without injured stars Nathan MacKinnon and Cale Makar.

news.title: Giroux, Stutzle score as Senators top Penguins, 4-1
news.ruTitle: Giroux, Stutzle score as Senators top Penguins, 4-1
news.description: — Claude Giroux scored a goal and the Ottawa Senators beat the Pittsburgh Penguins 4-1 on Saturday.

news.title: McDavid extends season-opening points streak to 21 games, Oilers beat Maple Leafs 1-0
news.ruTitle: McDavid extends season-opening points streak to 21 games, Oilers beat Maple Leafs 1-0
news.description: — Connor McDavid extended his season-opening points streak to 21 games with an assist, Devon Levi made 19 saves for his first NHL shutout and the Edmonton Oilers beat Toronto 1-0 on Saturday night to hand the Maple Leafs their sixth straight home loss.

news.title: Jamie Benn records 1,000th NHL point with goal in Stars' win
news.ruTitle: Jamie Benn records 1,000th NHL point with goal in Stars' win
news.description: Dallas captain Jamie Benn scored his 1,000th career NHL point during Saturday night's game with a goal against the Buffalo Sabres.

news.title: Wild beat Bruins 6-2 behind two goals from Ryan Hartman, extending road winning streak to 8 games
news.ruTitle: Wild beat Bruins 6-2 behind two goals from Ryan Hartman, extending road winning streak to 8 games
news.description: — Ryan Hartman and Danila Yurov scored two goals each, Jesper Wallstedt stopped 30 shots, and the Minnesota Wild beat the Boston Bruins 6-2 on Saturday night to extend their road winning streak to eight games.

news.title: Tkachuk brothers power Panthers to 4-1 win after Hall of Fame father honored by Blues
news.ruTitle: Tkachuk brothers power Panthers to 4-1 win after Hall of Fame father honored by Blues
news.description: — Brady and Matthew Tkachuk participated in a pregame ceremony to honor their father, then led the Florida Panthers to a 4-1 win over the St. Louis Blues on Saturday night.

news.title: Tarasov gets shutout, Raymond has 2 points as Red Wings defeat Lightning 2-0
news.ruTitle: Tarasov gets shutout, Raymond has 2 points as Red Wings defeat Lightning 2-0
news.description: — Daniil Tarasov stopped 31 shots for his second shutout of the season, Lucas Raymond had a goal and two points and the Detroit Red Wings beat the Tampa Bay Lightning 2-0 on Saturday.
